text: Reddit research 2026-11-04: pulled 3 threads Alex handed over and built the thread catalog. (1) r/StableDiffusion 1xlaj6u (zeroedit, 29 up, 43 comments): framing tokens are NOT instructions - training captions are VLM scene graphs, so 'you can see them from head to thighs' is meaningless; cover the frame with described content/action ('looking directly at the viewer and smiling'). Filmmaking terms work for camera moves/angles, not composition. Camera motion is prompt-text-only over a FIXED 20-phrase vocabulary (S4.3 of the guide we already vendor) with amplitude/speed modifiers, and every move needs a TARGET to land on; 'camera' can be misread as a literal object in scene (say 'talking to the viewer'). (2) r/comfyui 1xl8hgc (130 up, 55 comments): the identity route is character swap - akatz-ai/MiniMax-H3-Character-Swap-LoRA (HF, 140258 downloads, 710 likes, ref2va base Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3) and D3voz/openjutsu (1644 stars, MIT, pushed 2026-10-30: H3 video + SAM 3.1 person tracking + Qwen3-VL 8B describer, Next.js over a ComfyUI workflow, DMAD 6-step, FLUX.3 Klein relighting) which the OP called 'the actual answer'; also Comfy-Org/comfy-openjutsu and Bambushu/h3-recast. Full-precision text encoder improves adherence. (3) Re-checked 1xif258 comment 19rv7151xjqv7: unchanged, score 6, 0 replies; xb1n0ry's promised H3 prompt-enhancer node has NOT appeared (his GitHub newest push 2026-10-18) - stop watching. I probed every one of the 141 chunk names with no local take via /view on tombstone (subfolder=video is REQUIRED - without it all 404) and recovered 7 (S03-c01/c02, S05-c01..c04 preseeded, S11-c30); 134 returned 404 = NOT on the rig. HONEST YIELD: 122 of 256 chunks have a take, 134 missing, cause = our dead puller (pending tombstone's answer on how far the queue actually got; /queue is 0/0 everywhere now and tombstone /history is 0 records post-reboot). tools/pull_5090.py gained --names/--subfolder/--dest (post-reboot recovery route). New tools/qc_audioled.py -> runs/yolo_qc.jsonl, 129/129 PASS (black/frozen/silence). FIXED A REAL BUG in core/overnight_qc.py: the freeze detector was INERT - ffmpeg logs 'freeze_start: 0' WITH a space, the regex wanted none, and a freeze running to the last frame emits no duration at all, so a 6s solid-colour control clip scored PASS and every prior QC run's frozen_s was a hard 0 (all 494 baseline rows). Now whitespace-tolerant + unterminated tail counted as frozen; re-ran the baseline -> fullrun/qc-results.recheck.jsonl 494/494 PASS with 8 rows now carrying real freeze time (0.83-2.83s), verdicts unchanged. Controls (black/frozen-to-EOF/silent) all fire. Audio-led (yolo) semantic audit DONE 2026-11-04 (the question the 10-27 19:43 audit left open, since the bounded-crowd GROUP_CONSTRAINT landed 19:57 after it). 7 chunks x 2 takes read by the 32B with identical prompts/frames (runs/yolo_diag/takecmp.jsonl, driver runs/diag_yolo_takes.py, images downscaled <=1024px): the clause collapsed the unconstrained cloned crowd from 'dozens' to 3-5 and cleaned ONE chunk outright (G02-c01: 'no extra people, only NEKRON and TEEGRA'), but 6 of 7 post-fix takes STILL invent people -> the guard is necessary, not sufficient. Mechanism: runs/build_technicolor_audio_only.py picks the cast clause from the SCENE PREFIX (scene.startswith('G'), line 234) while every one of those chunks' BLOCKING describes 1-5 named figures and no extras (G03-c05 literally says 'none are background extras'), so the prompt asserts a crowd its own blocking denies and H3 populates a small one. ROOT CAUSE of the repeated brown-leather extras: TEEGRA_sheet_t01_00001_.png is OFF-CANON - the 32B reads it as 'dark brown leather-like two-piece', while traits.txt says purple, and the 1983 source frames id_TEEGRA.jpg / shot_00270_f00000.jpg read 'purple'/'lavender'. That sheet is in 137 of 276 graphs of the batch, so H3 gets two costumes for one character and dresses the invented people in the sheet's brown. So a re-queue of the 134 missing takes (board row 11) would reproduce the failure on the current sheet. WROTE: docs/h3_audit_audio_led_group_scenes_2026-11-04.md (full write-up), tools/audit_sheets_vs_traits.py + manifests/sheet_traits_audit.jsonl (13 sheets vs their traits, TEEGRA MISMATCH on the first run), runs/diag_yolo_takes.py. Coord board: row 2 updated, row 13 added (off-canon sheet), pushed. Next per the doc: fix TEEGRA's sheet or adopt brown as canon consistently, make the cast clause follow the blocking, then re-queue.

CORRECTION to my own yolo audit entry (i=184): I claimed the bounded-crowd clause 'collapsed the cloned crowd from dozens to 3-5'. That was wrong as stated - it conflated the historical 2026-10-27 audit's numbers with mine. Under identical measurement (same prompts, same frame extraction, both takes) the clause is NOT a demonstrated improvement: headcount 3 better / 4 worse of 7, extras flagged in 6 of 7 post-fix takes and 6 of 7 pre-fix, exactly one chunk clean afterwards (G02-c01). Worse, the '15-20 identical brown-leather women' figure that condemned the batch came from the 10-27 audit of the SAME 00001 takes; re-reading those takes on fresh frames gives 1-6 people - so that severity is at least partly an artifact of WHICH FRAMES the auditor sampled (a crowd must be in the sampled frame to be counted). Every headcount in either audit is soft. What survives as solid: extras appear in the group chunks, they wear the same brown leather, and that leather is TEEGRA_sheet_t01's (row 13); and the prompt contradicts its own blocking (crowd clause chosen from the scene prefix while the blocking describes 1-5 figures, G03-c05 saying 'none are background extras'). Corrected in docs/h3_audit_audio_led_group_scenes_2026-11-04.md section 1 and in coord board row 2. LESSON: before comparing two measurements, check they were taken the same way - and when a severity figure from an earlier audit is the whole reason a batch was condemned, re-read the same takes on fresh samples before repeating it.

Sheet-vs-canon audit done 2026-11-04 (why: the group-scene extras all wore the same brown leather, and that traces to the reference the model is seeded from). Audited all 13 sheets the audio-led batch consumed - tools/audit_sheets_vs_traits.py, ledger manifests/sheet_traits_audit.jsonl, one 32B call per character (sheet + its traits.txt), images <=1024px, one model, no evictions. RESULT 1: only 4 of 13 are checkable at all - NINE characters have no non-empty refs/characters/<NAME>/traits.txt (NEKRON, JAROL, TARO, ROLIEL, JULIANA, ENVOY, SUBHUMAN CAPTAIN, SUBHUMAN have no file; LARN's is 0 bytes). RESULT 2: all four that can be checked MISMATCH their canon - TEEGRA (sheet brown leather vs canon purple, plus tan vs pale skin), TUTOR (leather armour with bronze plates vs 'ochre hide robe, woven vest with bone toggles'), DARKWOLF (no wolf's-head hood, no yellow eyes, no teeth-and-skull pendant - the defining feature is simply absent), SPIRIT (black fabric top/pants + white hair vs 'crimson hair, hide top, blue woven collar'). Two mechanisms: stale-by-ruling (TUTOR + SPIRIT carry canon dated 2026-10-28 while their sheets were rendered 2026-10-23) and never-carried-the-feature (DARKWOLF, TEEGRA). TRAP FOUND AND FIXED: asked to compare a sheet against an EMPTY traits file the 32B FABRICATED the canon - for LARN it asserted 'the canonical costume is maroon (not black)' out of a 0-byte file, and invented 'typical tribal warrior attire' for the no-file characters; nine confident verdicts that meant nothing. The tool now writes a NO_CANON row instead of asking, and those 9 rows were deleted from the ledger rather than reported. WROTE docs/h3_sheet_traits_audit_2026-11-04.md; coord board row 13 updated with the result and row 14 added (missing canon files); pushed 4f1a3b1. WHY IT MATTERS UPSTREAM: a sheet is the identity anchor for every take listing that character and TEEGRA alone is in 137 of 276 graphs, so a sheet whose costume contradicts the prompt's gives H3 two looks for one character - which is what dresses the invented crowd in the sheet's brown. Next: write the 9 missing traits.txt (text is Alex's call), re-render the 4 mismatched sheets against their traits, and gate a batch on this audit (13 cheap calls) before paying for 256 renders.
